summary: Re-verified DVR camera-filter regression fix. The membership-aware setSelected updater now correctly reselects a segment from the newly filtered set when the previous selection is filtered out. All primary and secondary DVR flows pass.
critical_code_review_comments: DVR.jsx line 21: fix is correct - setSelected((cur) => (cur && s.some(x => x.id === cur.id)) ? cur : (s[0] || null)) properly clears/reassigns when current selection is filtered out. Also handles empty list by setting null (Playback shows 'NO SEGMENTS' as expected).
seed_data_creation: None. TEST_PI seg still present from earlier iterations; harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: DVR regression path fully resolved. Verified: initial auto-select of Front Porch segment; switching camera filter to Backyard updates Playback to the Backyard segment (Low-level motion / animal tag); switching to Driveway updates Playback to Driveway segment (Routine coming/going); switching to 'All cameras' retains valid selection and shows 7 segments; nonsense search yields 0 segments and 'NO SEGMENTS' placeholder; clicking any dvr-segment-{id} updates Playback; seg-len 15/30/60 and retention 24/48/72 toasts fire without errors. Note: camera_name is rendered in the PanelHeader (right slot), not inside [data-testid='dvr-player'] - verify via body content (ai_summary/tags) or by scoping to the parent Panel.
rca of the issue: Previously fixed. Root cause was functional setSelected updater that only replaced when cur was falsy. Current code checks membership of cur in the new segments list and falls back to s[0] or null. Verified via UI: Backyard-only filter yields exactly the Backyard segment in Playback content.
